motion_summary: Eternal Return Bianca Reign of the Vampire Queen: teal bangs and long hair, red eyes, black gothic bonnet and black/crimson lace vampire dress exactly per reference. R chants, fixes a magic circle to ground, then blood magic finale heals herself. 12 poses: ready; tiny haughty smile and hand at chest; raise right hand with delicate curled fingers; both arms spread and crimson rune-like geometric circle appears at feet WITHOUT readable letters; body rises very slightly with arms extended; tilt head and rotate wrist controlling blood magic; circle pulse expands; lean forward and draw both hands inward; compact dark-crimson spike-like waves erupt around ground circle below face; red motes flow toward chest and heal; lower arms as bonnet/ribbons settle; ready. Elegant ritual hand/torso choreography, no bat transform and no coffin. Red effects must not cover face. Landscape4:3, 4×3 equal square cells, 12 distinct poses and transparent generous margins.
